name: Mysore Sandal Soap
about: A soap made with sandalwood, a fragrance that Karnataka is famous for. Mysore is the home of this traditional scent, so it is a classic gift from Bengaluru.
tip: Check that the packaging is genuine before you buy.

name: Karnataka Filter Coffee
where: Cothas Coffee or Coffee Day Fresh & Ground
about: A South Indian coffee blend, brewed with a metal filter and often served with milk. Filter coffee is a daily ritual across Karnataka.
tip: Check how much chicory is in the blend, since many local blends include it.
